capabilities: challenge the ideas in the open note using OpenAI
insert a nemesis response via a left-sidebar icon
configure an OpenAI API key in the plugin settings
extras: README is minimal and still shows the sample plugin heading; usage is limited to install, add an OpenAI API key, and click the sidebar icon.
motivation: The author built it after seeing an interesting Reddit post about the idea.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI-generated critique or counterarguments against what you have written.
summary: AI plugin that sends the active note to OpenAI and returns a response that challenges your ideas.
